messages:
alejandra (Partnerships): heads-up — Snowflake & Databricks teams asked if we can run a joint PoC that wires Snowflake data -> Databricks compute -> vector DB + our connector for embeddings. They want marketplace readiness talk and a short hardware compatibility check with our OEM partners. looking to align for a late-april field trial.

sam (GTM): +1. Do we have a go-to-market proposal? co-marketing / datasheet + joint webinar? need PR lead and target audience.

mike (Eng): curious about connector flow. is the plan: 1) extract vectors in Databricks -> push to vector DB, 2) Redwood pulls vectors for retrieval-augmented generation? need auth details and perf targets. also, hw check: which GPU SKUs do partners want validated?

alejandra (Partnerships): exactly. high-level: ingestion from Snowflake via connector -> vectorization in Databricks (UDAF or job) -> index into vector DB (Qdrant/Weaviate/FAISS managed). Redwood runtime will be deployed in Dedicated for the demo to show latency & cost. OEM partner (NVIDIA/other) asked for perf runs on A100/L4 and a CPU fallback test.

harsh (Solutions): I can run a small field test with 3 customers in our beta cohort. need a simple checklist of artifacts from Eng & Product: sample SQL, connector config, test dataset (10k rows), success metrics.

nina (Product): success metrics: p95 latency < 200ms for 512-token queries, recall@5 >= 0.8 on curated eval set, and cost per query < $0.03 in Dedicated baseline. we should capture token/cost breakdown in console during demo.

mike (Eng): putting a quick config here for the PoC. please review:
```
connector.conf:
  snowflake_role: "READER_ROLE"
  databricks_job: "vectorize-job-v1"
  vector_db: "qdrant-host:6333"
  auth: "oauth2"
  batch_size: 256
  quantization: "8bit"
```
notes: we need an auth variant that supports customer-managed keys for Private deployments.

sam (GTM): timeline ask: if field trial late-April, we need a joint announcement draft by week of Apr 10, assets by Apr 17, and a marketplace listing asset pack (screenshots, cert) by Apr 24. legal/comms heads should be looped asap. @nina can you own announcement draft?

alejandra (Partnerships): I'll ping the Snowflake partner PM and Databricks PM today and set a joint sync for Thu 9am PT. also looping in hardware partner contact — asking for perf target confirmation.

harsh (Solutions): putting together a short test checklist in the repo. will share link when ready.

nina (Product): I can take the announcement draft. will need a partner quote and one-liner from hw partner. can someone confirm the partner copy approvals timeline?

sam (GTM): I'll start the comms plan and add PR owners. tagging legal: @legal-team (not in this thread) — we need standard co-marketing MSA or addendum.

vecdb-bot: vector-db-sync: health check OK for qdrant-stage, weaviate-stage down (401). will retry in 10m.

mike (Eng): note: we should test with both managed vector DBs and self-hosted to validate our fallback routing policy. I'll schedule perf runs on A100 and L4 next Tue.

alejandra (Partnerships): action items roundup: 1) aleja -> schedule partner sync Thu 9am PT (done) 2) nina -> announcement draft by Apr 10 3) mike -> perf runs + connector sample by Apr 3 4) harsh -> field test checklist + customer invites by Apr 7 5) sam -> comms plan + PR owners by Apr 5 6) legal/comms -> MSA check/approval timeline (ask)

sam (GTM): any blockers? otherwise I'll kick off the PR/marketplace checklist and add a page in the partner portal. :rocket:

alejandra (Partnerships): no blockers from my side. if anyone needs partner contacts, DM me. let's keep updates concise in this thread. :white_check_mark:
